audit.phase: Phase 2: Production-wiring scope & dead work (Cluster B)

checks.detail: Handler retains all three fail-closed auth checks: (1) active parent_links row for (parentProfileId, studentId) via by_parent_and_student index, (2) student profile exists, (3) student.role === 'student'. No regression from baseline — the diff only replaces the module-1 JSON import with loadFullCurriculumGraph() and narrows the learnerState union type.

No explicit identity check at baseline, no explicit identity check at HEAD — no regression. The handler is an internalQuery that filters placement_results by args.userId. Auth boundary is at the calling Convex function layer (pre-existing design unchanged by Phase 2).

checks.description: skill-graph-loader.ts reads from static JSON only — no HTTP, no user input, no path construction
checks.detail: Implementation uses two static JSON imports (import fullNodesJson from '../../curriculum/skill-graph/nodes.json'). Resolved at build time via TypeScript resolveJsonModule. No fs.readFile, no fetch/HTTP, no user-controlled paths, no request data in path construction. Returns module-scoped constants by reference — no per-call JSON parsing.

checks.description: Multi-module projection must not leak data across students
checks.detail: Test uses single STUDENT_ID with 2 placement rows (module-1 and module-2), both for same student. Handler queries placement_results filtered by studentId via by_student index — unchanged from baseline. Mock ctx properly scopes eq() filtering. No opportunity for cross-student leak introduced by Phase 2 changes.

checks.description: Dead student_competency JSDoc claim removed; new JSDoc is accurate
checks.detail: getStudentVisualizationHandler JSDoc (lines 467-485) correctly says 'Loads the full curriculum skill graph from JSON' — no stale student_competency claim. skill-graph-loader.ts JSDoc accurately documents root vs per-module decision, node/edge counts, and static-import behaviour. buildParentProjectionPayload JSDoc updated from 'module-1' to 'full curriculum knowledge graph'.

checks.description: Skill-graph JSON is curriculum artifact only — no student records, credentials, or secrets
checks.detail: nodes.json (574 nodes) and edges.json (2708 edges) contain only curriculum metadata: id, kind, title, description, domain, sourceRefs, reviewStatus, metadata. Grep for studentId/userId/profile/email returned 0 matches. Grep for password/secret/token/api_key/jwt/credential returned false positives on 'key features' substring in standard descriptions — not actual secrets.

checks.description: No new as any or @ts-ignore annotations in modified files
checks.detail: Full git diff 56868819..HEAD across all 5 modified files: zero matches for 'as any', '@ts-ignore', or '@ts-expect-error'. The skill-graph-loader's JSON import casts (fullNodesJson as { nodes: KnowledgeSpaceNode[] }) use the same pattern present at baseline.

checks.description: FR-3 balanced-brace guard exit 0 on production scope
checks.detail: bash check-jsdoc-balanced-braces.sh 'apps/ packages/ convex/' → Scanned 2242 files, 664 typed tags, 0 violations, exit 0. Phase 1 JSDoc invariant preserved across all Phase 2 changes.

checks.description: review_due union member removed from handler-local types
checks.detail: git grep "'review_due'" across student.ts and parent/visualization.ts → 0 matches. Both handlers now declare learnerState as 'mastered' | 'ready' | 'blocked'. Downstream projection (packages/knowledge-space-practice) continues to accept broader union — no production impact.

known_limitations.description: The behavioral invariant test in visualizationLearnerStateUnion.test.ts (handler classifies placements only as mastered/ready/blocked) times out at default 5000ms because the handler now loads the full 574-node graph through projectStudentVisualization. The two source-level assertions (no 'review_due' in handler source files) pass correctly. This is a test infrastructure concern, not a security or production issue — the handler code correctly never emits 'review_due'.

handoff: Phase 2 security review complete. All auth gates, validation, and data boundaries intact. No regressions in parent-link verification or student-data scoping. skill-graph-loader is a safe static-JSON helper with no I/O surface. The only known limitation is a test timeout in visualizationLearnerStateUnion behavioral invariant due to full 574-node graph projection — source-level assertions pass. Ready for phase-acceptance.
